story.title: Story 2: Search, Skim, And Full Detail

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 2 search/skim/detail support by adding a real store-backed workbench search service, extending the query service with message/turn/thread-view detail reads and pivots, and covering the story with the planned search and detail unit tests.

changedFiles.reason: Added content + metadata search for messages, turns, and Thread Views with skim-friendly summary rows and stable ordering.
Extended workbench reads to open full message, turn, and Thread View detail payloads and expose related-record pivots.
Added store-backed Story 2 coverage for search, skim summaries, metadata filters, relationship hints, empty results, and non-TC ordering/summary-shape checks.
Added Story 2 detail and pivot coverage for message, turn, and Thread View inspection flows.

findingsFixed: Implemented linear-scan search over canonical thread records and persisted Thread Views instead of a fake read model.
Added compact summary-shaped search rows with relationship hints so long result sets do not require full-detail payloads.
Added message-to-turn, turn-to-view-placement, and Thread View source-selection pivots in the query service.
Covered the Story 2 TC set plus the two planned non-TC search checks with 22 new unit tests.
findingsSurfaced: The configured story gate still fails for this story because `guard:no-test-changes` rejects the required modified/new test files in the working tree (`tests/context-workbench/workbench-query-service.test.ts`, `tests/context-workbench/workbench-search-service.test.ts`).

result.recommendedNextStep: Resolve or waive the `green-verify` test-change guard for this story, then proceed to verifier handoff using the passing `npm run verify-all` evidence.
